summary: Clinuvel Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K furnishing an Australian Securities Exchange Appendix 3H notification of cessation of securities, signed by Managing Director and CEO Philippe Wolgen on October 15, 2026. The filing is a routine ASX administrative disclosure of expired or cancelled securities and contains no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms. No special-situation event is present; there is no deal or risk-arb angle to evaluate. This maps to a US Form 8-K current report of an ordinary administrative notice.
